summary: Indian stocks head into Friday after a third straight small gain, but inflation above the RBI's 6% ceiling and weak US tech futures point to a more cautious start.

detail.leaders: Realty and banks, which led Thursday; Oil India after strong results
detail.laggards: Rate-sensitive stocks after the inflation breach; IT if US tech weakness persists
detail.tone: A forward-looking read for Friday's session. More cautious than the previous note, with weak US tech futures now adding to the inflation surprise.
